review_evidence: HexGramSchmidt/Update.lean defines sizeReduce and adjacentSwap and proves their effects on bases and Gram-Schmidt coefficients.
The Int subtree develops invariants, exact integer/scaled formulations, combinations, canonical forms, and correspondence theorems.
The repository therefore owns both algorithms and the proof infrastructure needed for later LLL verification.
summary: Retain hex-gram-schmidt as a substantive executable and verified Gram-Schmidt development for integer and rational matrices.
